purpose: Exercise one formula-independent kinematic-axis observation rule on all six open galaxies and rescore the fixed formulas on P0749 adaptive twins before freezing the final holdout protocol.
developmentDisclosure: Every velocity field in P0750 was already revealed by P0744 or P0746. P0750 develops an observation policy; it is neither validation nor holdout evidence.

observationPolicy.phaseEstimator: gas-and-inverse-variance-weighted least squares of systemic-subtracted observed velocity on cos(theta) and sin(theta) over the unchanged reveal-stage score mask
observationPolicy.systemicVelocity: unchanged corresponding P0744 or P0746 reveal value
observationPolicy.prediction: discard fitted harmonic amplitude and use only its unit phase identically for every gravity formula

claimBoundary: The kinematic axis is one formula-independent observation-coordinate nuisance, not a gravity-law fit.
The least-squares amplitude is reported as a diagnostic but discarded before every prediction.
P0750 may justify a predeclared holdout observation policy but cannot be called validation because all six targets are open.
Neither NGC2841 nor NGC7331 has any pixel array opened in this stage.
